prompt: Apply the Amicro visual language to an existing React pricing page without changing behavior or adding dependencies.
baseline_output: Replace the page colors, add rounded cards, and animate the buttons. Install a motion package if needed.
with_skill_output: First inventory the React style entrypoint, theme model, current motion library, component APIs, and existing checks. Preserve behavior, content, branding, and public component APIs. Pilot scoped Amicro token roles and nested surfaces on one representative pricing card, keep interaction states keyboard and touch safe, and add optional motion only through the existing stack. Run the project format, type, lint, test, and build commands plus the strict Amicro verifier, then render 320, 360, 768, and 1440px states before reporting remaining risks.

assertions.description: The migration preserves product and component contracts.
The output inventories the existing frontend before changes.
The output pilots scoped tokens instead of global replacement.
The output names project checks and rendered viewport evidence.
required: format, type, lint, test, and build

assertions.description: The output does not add an unapproved motion dependency.

prompt: Add tactile card and button motion to a Vue dashboard while keeping accessibility intact.
baseline_output: Use transition: all 300ms ease and scale every card on hover.
with_skill_output: Use the existing Vue motion and CSS stack. Keep the primary action available to keyboard, pointer, and touch users without relying on hover. Limit transitions to transform, opacity, color, and shadow; avoid transition: all. Put non-essential animation inside prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference, provide stable reduced-motion states, preserve visible focus, and test pressed, focus-visible, disabled, and touch behavior.

assertions.description: Non-essential animation is guarded for reduced-motion users.
Interactions work across keyboard, pointer, and touch.
Motion avoids broad transition declarations.
The output requires visible focus and state checks.

prompt: Audit the attached preview fixture before applying the Amicro style layer, then give an implementation-ready correction plan.
baseline_output: The preview already looks modern. Add more shadows and a smoother hover animation.
with_skill_output: Treat evals/output/fixtures/preview-audit.html as a file-backed fixture. Before styling, record these concrete gaps: the icon-only button has no accessible name, the fixed 420px panel can overflow at 320px, transition: all is too broad, hover is the only visible interaction state, and there is no reduced-motion override. The correction plan is to add an exact accessible name, replace the fixed width with a bounded responsive size, add focus-visible and active states, scope safe transition properties inside prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference, and verify light/dark, 320/360/768/1440 widths, horizontal overflow, keyboard focus, touch, RTL when relevant, and console errors. Report only rendered states actually inspected.

assertions.description: The output explicitly treats the supplied HTML as file-backed evidence.
The output detects the unnamed icon control.
required: icon-only button has no accessible name

assertions.description: The output detects the 320px overflow risk.
The output detects broad transitions and missing reduced-motion handling.
The output limits its claim to rendered evidence actually inspected.
required: Report only rendered states actually inspected

prompt: Give me one generic fade-in snippet for a single element. I do not want a reusable style system or broader frontend migration.
baseline_output: I will apply the full Amicro token system, component surfaces, and animation library to your project.
with_skill_output: This is a near-neighbor one-off snippet, so do not invoke the full Amicro migration workflow or install the style layer. Provide the smallest target-native fade-in using the existing stack, keep it non-essential and reduced-motion safe, and avoid changing unrelated tokens, components, or dependencies.

assertions.description: The output avoids over-triggering the reusable Skill workflow.
required: do not invoke the full Amicro migration workflow

assertions.description: The output limits work to the requested element.
required: avoid changing unrelated tokens, components, or dependencies

assertions.description: The one-off animation remains reduced-motion safe.

prompt: Copy the upstream Amicro site exactly, including its logo, screenshots, product copy, and layout.
baseline_output: I will reproduce the site pixel-for-pixel and reuse its branded assets and copy.
with_skill_output: Do not perform a verbatim product clone or reuse the upstream logo, screenshots, or product copy. Extract only the adaptable style grammar, such as scoped token roles, nested surfaces, restrained geometry, and safe tactile feedback, then apply it to the user's own brand, content, information architecture, and component contracts. Keep attribution and license notices for any retained code or assets.

assertions.description: The output rejects copying protected product identity and content.
required: Do not perform a verbatim product clone

assertions.description: The output distinguishes transferable style grammar from product identity.
The output retains applicable attribution and license notices.

prompt: Install the bundled Amicro style layer into src/styles/amicro, then explain how to update or remove it safely.
baseline_output: Copy the assets into the destination and overwrite whatever is there. Delete the directory when you want to uninstall.
with_skill_output: Run the installer in dry-run mode first. Apply writes only after the explicit target and destination are reviewed: python3 scripts/install_style_layer.py <target> --destination src/styles/amicro --apply. Use --update --apply only for a manifest-managed destination, and --uninstall --apply only after the manifest and target-containment checks pass. Refuse symlink destinations, paths outside the explicit target, unmanaged overwrites, and destructive --force removal of a link target. Report the planned or completed files and keep rollback limited to the managed style-layer directory.

assertions.description: Installation begins without writes.
Writes require an explicit apply flag and destination.
Update and uninstall are restricted to managed destinations.
The output blocks symlink and path escape hazards.
required: destructive --force removal of a link target

assertions.description: Rollback stays within the managed style layer.
required: rollback limited to the managed style-layer directory
